question.text: If $E$ and $F$ are two independent events with $P(E)=0.3$ and $P(E \cup F)=0.5$, then $P(E / F)-P(F / E)$ equals

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& \text {  } P(E \cup F)=P(E)+P(F)-P(E \cap F) \\
& \Rightarrow 0.5=0.3+P(F)-P(E) \cdot P(F) \\
& \Rightarrow 0.2=P(F)-0.3 P(F) \\
& \Rightarrow P(F)=\frac{2}{7}
\end{aligned}$

So, $P(E / F)-P(F / E)=P(E)-P(F)=\frac{3}{10}-\frac{2}{7}=\frac{21-20}{70}=\frac{1}{70}$
